tasks.description: The login flow should be defined to ensure a seamless user experience. This includes determining the authentication method and user session management. The definition should be detailed enough to guide the implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid username and password, when the user attempts to log in, then they are redirected to the dashboard.

tasks.description: A list of report types should be compiled to understand the requirements for the customer portal's reporting feature. This list will guide the development of the reporting system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of report types, when the user requests a report, then the system generates the correct report type.

tasks.description: The notification settings should be detailed to ensure that users receive the correct notifications. This includes determining the types of notifications and the frequency of notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's notification preferences, when an event occurs, then the user receives the correct notification.

tasks.description: The background section of the customer portal document should be written to provide context and history. This will help in understanding the purpose and goals of the portal.
acceptance_criteria: Given the background section, when a new team member reads it, then they understand the context and history of the customer portal.

tasks.description: Acceptance criteria should be defined for each feature of the customer portal to ensure that the development meets the requirements. This includes determining the test cases and validation rules.
acceptance_criteria: Given a feature, when the acceptance criteria are defined, then the feature can be tested and validated.
